title: Foundry Pour
sceneLabel: Line drawing of a foundry pouring bay in a continuous loop: a hand wheel turns a 40 to 1 worm gearbox that tilts a refractory-lined ladle on its trunnions, a stream of molten steel falls into the pouring basin and the steel rises through the sprue, runner and gates into the sand mould and its two risers, then the casting freezes and a new mould and ladle begin again, while a pyrometer on a tripod reads the stream; on hover the ladle, drive, counterweight, flasks, basin and pyrometer come apart
